arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعَنْتَنِي عَلَى خَتْمِ كِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَهُ نُوراً وَجَعَلْتَهُ مُهَيْمِناً عَلَى كُلِّ كِتَاب أَنْزَلْتَهُ، وَفَضَّلْتَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ حَدِيث قَصَصْتَهُ،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka aʿantani ʿalā khatmi kitābik al-ladhī anzaltahu nūran wa jaʿaltahu muhayminan ʿalā kulli kitābin anzaltahu wafadhdhaltahu ʿalaa kulli ḥadiith qassashtahu
english_text: O God, Thou hast helped me complete Thy Book, which Thou sent down as a light and appointed as a guardian over every book Thou hast sent down, preferring it over every narrative which Thou hast recounted,

arabic_text: وَفُرْقاناً فَرَقْتَ بِهِ بَيْنَ حَلالِكَ وَحَرَامِكَ، وَقُرْآناً أَعْرَبْتَ بِهِ عَنْ شَرَائِعِ أَحْكَامِكَ، وَكِتَاباً فَصَّلْتَهُ لِعِبَادِكَ تَفْصِيلاً، وَوَحْياً أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّد صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ تَنْزِيلاً،
transliteration: wa furqānan faraqta bihī bayna ḥalālika wa ḥarāmika wa qur'ānan 'aʿrabta bihi ʿan sharāʾiʿi ahkāmika wa kitāban faṣṣaltahu li'ibādika tafṣīlā wa wahyan anzaltahu ʿala nabiyyika muhammad ṣalātuka ʿalayhi wa ālihi tanzīlan
english_text: a separator, through which Thou hast separated Thy lawful from Thy unlawful, a Qur'an, through which Thou hast made plain the approaches to Thy ordinances, a book, which Thou hast distinguished very distinctly for Thy servants, a revelation, which Thou hast sent down, a sending down, upon Thy prophet Muhammad (Thy blessings be upon him and his Household).

arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتَهُ نُوراً نَهْتَدِي مِنْ ظُلَمِ الضَّلاَلَةِ وَالْجَهَـالَةِ بِـاتِّبَاعِـهِ، وَشِفَـاءً لِمَنْ أَنْصَتَ بِفَهْم التَّصْدِيقِ إلَى اسْتِمَاعِهِ، وَمِيزَانَ قِسْط لاَ يَحِيْفُ عَنِ الْحَقِّ لِسَانُهُ، وَنُورَ هُدىً لاَ يُطْفَأُ عَنِ الشَّاهِدِينَ بُرْهَانُهُ،
transliteration: wajaʿaltahu nuran nahtadi min zulami al-dhalalati wal-jahalati bi at-tibaʿihi wa-shifā'an li-man anṣata bi-fahmi al-taṣdīqi ilā istimā'ih wa mīzāna qisṭin lā yaḥīfu ʿani al-ḥaqqi lisānuhu wa nūra hudan lā yuṭfa'u ʿani alshāhidīna burhānuhu
english_text: Thou appointed it a light through following which we may be guided from the shadows of error and ignorance, a healing for him who turns ear toward hearing it with the understanding of attestation, a just balance whose tongue does not incline away from truth, a light of guidance whose proof is not extinguished before the witnesses,

arabic_text: وَعَلَمَ نَجَاة لاَ يَضِلُّ مَنْ أَمَّ قَصْدَ سُنَّتِهِ وَلاَ تَنَالُ أَيْدِي الْهَلَكَاتِ مَنْ تَعَلَّقَ بِعُرْوَةِ عِصْمَتِهِ،
transliteration: waʿalama najāt la yadillu man amma qasd sunnatihi wa lā tanālu aydī al-halakāt man taʿallaqa biʿurwatī ʿiṣmatih
english_text: and a guidepost of deliverance, so that he who repairs straightway to its prescription will not go astray and he who clings to its preservation's handhold will not be touched by the hands of disasters.

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَإذْ أَفَدْتَنَا الْمعُونَةَ عَلَى تِلاَوَتِهِ، وَسَهَّلْتَ جَوَاسِيَ أَلْسِنَتِنَا بِحُسْنِ عِبَارَتِهِ، فَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَرْعَاهُ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ، وَيَدِينُ لَكَ بِاعْتِقَادِ التَّسْلِيْمِ لِمُحْكَمِ آياتِهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma fa'itha afadtanā almuaūnata 'alā tilāwatihi wasahhaltal jawāsiya al-sinatinā bihusni ʿibāratihi fajʿalna mimman yarʿahu haqqa riʿayatihi wayadīnu laka biiʿtiqādi attaslīmi limuḥkami āyātihi
english_text: O God, since Thou hast given us help to recite it and made smooth the roughness of our tongues through the beauty of its expression, place us among those who observe it as it should be observed, serve Thee by adhering in submission to the firm text of its verses,

arabic_text: وَيَفْزَعُ إلى الإِقْرَارِ بِمُتَشَابِهِهِ وَمُوضَحَاتِ بَيِّناتِهِ.
transliteration: wayafzaʿu ilā al-iqrāri bi-mutashābihihī wa-mūḍaḥāti bayyinātihī
english_text: and seek refuge in admitting both its ambiguous parts and the elucidations of its clear signs!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَنْزَلْتَهُ عَلَى نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّد صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ مُجْمَلاً، وَأَلْهَمْتَهُ عِلْمَ عَجَائِبِهِ مُكَمَّلاً، وَوَرَّثْتَنَا عِلْمَهُ مُفَسَّراً،
transliteration: allāhumma innaka anzaltahu ʿalā nabiyyika muḥammad ṣallá allāhu ʿalayhi wa-ālihi mujmalan wa 'alhamtahu 'ilm-a 'aja'ibihi mukammalan wa warraithtana ʿilmahu mufassiran
english_text: O God, Thou sent it down upon Thy prophet Muhammad (God bless him and his household) in summary form, Thou inspired him with the science of its wonders to complement it, Thou made us the heirs of its knowledge as interpreters,

arabic_text: وَفَضَّلْتَنَا عَلَى مَنْ جَهِلَ عِلْمَهُ، وَقَوَّيْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ لِتَرْفَعَنَا فَوْقَ مَنْ لَمْ يُطِقْ حَمْلَهُ.
transliteration: wa faḍḍaltanā ʿalá man jahila ʿilmahu waqawwaytanā ʿalayhi litarfaʿanā fawqa man lam yuṭiq ḥamlahu
english_text: Thou made us to surpass him who is ignorant of its knowledge, and Thou gave us strength over it to raise us above those not able to carry it.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا جَعَلْتَ قُلُوبَنَا لَهُ حَمَلَةً، وَعَرَّفْتَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ شَرَفَهُ وَفَضْلَهُ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد الْخَطِيْبِ بِهِ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ الْخُزّانِ لَهُ،
transliteration: allāhumma fakamā jaʿaltā qulūbanā lahū ḥamalatan wa ʿarraftanā birahmatika sharafahu wa faḍluhu faṣallī ʿalā muḥammad al-khaṭīb bih wa ʿalā ālihi al-khuzzāni lah
english_text: O God, just as Thou hast appointed our hearts as its carriers and made known to us through Thy mercy its nobility and excellence, so also bless Muhammad, its preacher, and his Household, its guardians,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَرِفُ بِأَنـَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ حَتَّى لاَ يُعَارِضَنَا الشَّكُّ فِي تَصْدِيقِهِ وَلاَ يَخْتَلِجَنَا الزَّيْغُ عَنْ قَصْدِ طَرِيقِهِ.
transliteration: wajʿalna mimman yaʿtarifu bi'annahu min ʿindika ḥattá lā yuʿāriḍanā ash-shakk fī taṣdīqih walā yakh'talijanā al-zayghu ʿan qaṣdi ṭarīqih
english_text: and place us among those who confess that it has come from Thee, lest doubt about attesting to it assail us, or deviation from its straightforward path shake us!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِمَّنْ يَعْتَصِمُ بِحَبْلِهِ، وَيَـأْوِي مِنَ الْمُتَشَـابِهَاتِ إلَى حِرْزِ مَعْقِلِهِ، وَيَسْكُنُ فِي ظِـلِّ جَنَاحِهِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-jaʿalna mimman yaʿtasimu bihablihi waya'wī min al-mutashābihāt ilā ḥirzi ma'qilih wayaskunu fi ẓilli janāhihi
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and make us one of those who hold fast to its cord, seek haven from its ambiguities in its fortified stronghold, rest in the shadow of its wing,

arabic_text: وَيَهْتَدِي بِضَوْءِ صَباحِِهِ، وَيَقْتَدِي بِتَبَلُّج إسْفَارِهِ، وَيَسْتَصْبحُ بِمِصْباحِهِ، وَلا يَلْتَمِسُ ألْهُدَى فِي غَيْرِهِ.
transliteration: wayahdī biḍawʾi ṣabāhihī wayaqtaḍī bi-taballuj isfārihi wa yastasbaḥu bi miṣbāhih walā yaltamisu al-hudā fī ghayrih
english_text: find guidance in the brightness of its morning, follow the shining of its disclosure, acquire light from its lamp, and beg not guidance from any other!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا نَصَبْتَ بِهِ مُحَمَّداً عَلَماً لِلدَّلالَةِ عَلَيْكَ، وَأَنْهَجْتَ بِآلِهِ سُبُلَ الرِّضَا إلَيْكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma wa kamā naṣabta bihi muḥammadan ʿalamā li-l-dalālati ʿalayk wa anhajta bi ālihi subula al-ridda ilayka
english_text: O God, just as through it Thou hast set up Muhammad as a guidepost to point to Thee and through his Household Thou hast made clear Thy good pleasure's roads to Thee,

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلِ القُرْآنَ وَسِيلَةً لَنَا إلَى أَشْرَفِ مَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ، وَسُلَّماً نَعْرُجُ فِيهِ إلَى مَحَلِّ السَّلامَةِ، وَسَبَباً نُجْزَى بِهِ النَّجاةَ فِي عَرْصَةِ الْقِيَامَةِ،
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waajʿalil-qur'āna wasīlan lanā ilā ashrafimanaāzili al-karāmah wa-sullamān naʿruju fīhī ilā maḥalli al-salāmah wasababan nu'jzā bihī al-najāt fī 'arṣaẗi al-qiyāmah
english_text: so also bless Muhammad and his Household and make the Qur'an our mediation to the noblest stations of Thy honour, a ladder by which we may climb to the place of safety, a cause for our being repaid with deliverance at the Plain of Resurrection,

arabic_text: وَذَرِيعَةً نُقْدِمُ بِهَا عَلَى نَعِيْمِ دَارِ الْمُقَامَةِ.
transliteration: waḏariʿatan nuqdimu bihā ʿalā naʿīmi dāri al-muqāmatah
english_text: and a means whereby we may reach the bliss of the House of Permanence!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاحْطُطْ بالْقُرْآنِ عَنَّا ثِقْلَ الأوْزَارِ، وَهَبْ لَنَا حُسْنَ شَمَائِلِ الأَبْرَارِ وَاقْفُ بِنَا آثَارَ الَّذِينَ قَامُوا لَكَ بِهِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-aḥṭuṭ bil-qur'āni ʿannā ṯiqla-l-'awzār wa hab lana ḥusna shamāʾili al-abrār waqfu binā āthāra alladhīna qāmū laka bihī
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, lessen for us through the Qur'an the weight of heavy sins, give to us the excellent qualities of the pious, and make us follow the tracks of those who stood before Thee

arabic_text: آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ حَتَّى تُطَهِّرَنَا مِنْ كُلِّ دَنَس بِتَطْهِيرِهِ، وَتَقْفُوَ بِنَا آثَارَ الَّذِينَ اسْتَضَـآءُوْا بِنُورِهِ، وَلَمْ يُلْهِهِمُ الأَمَلُ عَنِ الْعَمَـل فَيَقْطَعَهُمْ بِخُدَعِ غُرُورِهِ.
transliteration: ʾānāʾa allayli wa ʾaṭrāfa n-nahār ḥattá tuṭahhiranā min kulli danas bi-taṭhīrihi wa taqfū binā āthāra allaḏīna istaḍāʾū bi-nūrih walam yulhīhimu al-amalu ʿani al-ʿamali fayaqṭaʿahum bi-khudāʿi ghurūrihi
english_text: in the watches of the night and the ends of the day, such that Thou purifiest us from every defilement through its purification and makest us to follow the tracks of those who have taken illumination from its light and whom expectation has not distracted from works, cutting them off through its delusions' deceptions!

arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ واجْعَلِ القُرْآنَ لنا فِي ظُلَمِ اللَّيالِي مُونِساً وَمِنْ نَزَغَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَخَطَرَاتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ حَارِساً، وَلأقْدَامِنَا عَنْ نَقْلِهَا إلَى الْمَعَاصِيْ حَابِساً،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa'j'alil-qur'ana lana fi dhulami-l-layali mawnesan wa min nazaghati ash-shaytani wa khatarati al-wasawisi harisan wa-l-aqdāminā `an naqlihā 'ilā al-ma`āṣī habisan
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and appoint the Qur'an for us an intimate in the shadows of nights and a guardian against the instigations of Satan and confusing thoughts, for our feet an obstruction from passing to acts of disobedience,

arabic_text: وَلأِلْسِنَتِنَا عَنِ الْخَوْضِ فِي الباطِلِ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَا آفَة مُخْرِساً، وَلِجَوَارِحِنَا عَنِ اقْتِرَافِ الآثامِ زَاجِراً، وَلِمَا طَوَتِ الغَفْلَةُ عَنَّا مِنْ تَصَفُّحِ الاعْتِبَارِ نَاشِراً حَتَّى تُوصِلَ إلَى قُلُوبِنَا فَهْمَ عَجَائِبِهِ
transliteration: wa l'il-sinatina 'ani al-khawdi fi al-batili min ghayri ma 'afah mukhrisan wa lijawarihina ʿani iqtirafi al-āthāmi zājiran wa lima ṭawat al-ghaflah ʿannā min taṣaffuḥ al-iʿtibār nāshiran ḥattā tuwṣila ʾilā qulūbinā fahm ʿajāʾibihī
english_text: for our tongues a silencer without blight preventing a plunge into falsehood, for our limbs a restrainer from committing sins, and for the scrutiny of heedfulness rolled up in heedlessness an unroller, such that Thou attachest to our hearts the understanding of the Qur'an's wonders

arabic_text: وَزَوَاجِرَ أَمْثَـالِهِ الَّتِي ضَعُفَتِ الْجِبَالُ الرَّوَاسِي عَلَى صَلاَبَتِهَا عَنِ احْتِمَالِهِ.
transliteration: wa zawājira amthālihi allatī ḍaʿufatil jibālu al-rawāsi ʿalā ṣalābatihā ʿani iḥtimālihi
english_text: and its restraining similitudes which immovable mountains in all their solidity were too weak to carry!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَدِمْ بِالْقُرْانِ صَلاَحَ ظاهِرِنا، وَاحْجُبْ بِهِ خَطَراتِ الْوَسَاوِسِ عَنْ صِحَّةِ ضَمَائِرِنَا، وَاغْسِلْ بِهِ دَرَنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَعَلاَئِقَ أَوْزَارِنَا،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-adim bil-qur'āni ṣalāḥaẓ-ẓāhirinā waḥjub bihi khaṭarāt al-wasāwis ʿan ṣiḥḥat ḍamaʾirinā wa-ghsil bihi darana qulubina wa'alaʾiq auzarina
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and through the Qur'an make permanent the rightness of our outward selves, veil the ideas of confusing thoughts from the soundness of our innermost minds, wash away the dirt of our hearts and the ties of our heavy sins,

arabic_text: وَاجْمَعْ بِهِ مُنْتَشَرَ أُمُورِنَا، وَأَرْوِ بِهِ فِي مَـوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ظَمَأ هَوَاجِرِنَا، وَاكْسُنَا بِهِ حُلَلَ الأَمَانِ يَوْمَ الْفَزَعِ الأكْبَرِ فِي نشُورِنَا.
transliteration: waajmaʿ bihi muntashara umoorina wa arwi bihi fi mawqifil 'ardhi 'alayka thama'a hawajirina wa-khusunā bihī ḥulala al-amān yawma al-fazaʿi al-akbar fī našūrinā
english_text: gather our scattered affairs, quench the thirst of our burning heat in the standing place of the presentation to Thee, and clothe us in the robes of security on the Day of the Greatest Terror at our uprising!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْبُرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ خَلَّتَنَا مِنْ عَدَمِ الإمْلاَقِ، وَسُقْ إلَيْنَا بِهِ رَغَدَ الْعَيْشِ وَخِصْبَ سَعَةِ الأرْزَاقِ، وَجَنِّبْنَا بِهِ الضَّرَائِبَ الْمَذْمُومَةَ وَمَدَانِيَ الأخْلاَقِ،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waajbur bil-qur'aani khal-latanaa min 'adam il'im-laaq wa suq ilayna bihi raghad al-'aysh wa khisb sa'ati al-arzaq wajannibnā bihi al-ḍarāʾib al-madhmuuma wa madānīya al-akh-lāq
english_text: God, bless Muhammad and his Household and through the Qur'an redress our lack - our destitution in poverty drive toward us the comforts of life and an abundance of plentiful provisions, turn aside blameworthy character traits and base moral qualities,

arabic_text: وَاعْصِمْنَا بِهِ مِنْ هُوَّةِ الكُفْرِ وَدَوَاعِـي النِّفَاقِ حَتَّى يَكُوْنَ لَنَا فِي الْقِيَامَةِ إلَى رِضْوَانِكَ وَجِنَانِكَ قَائِداً وَلَنَا فِي الدُّنْيا عَنْ سَخَطِكَ وَتَعَدِّي حُدُودِكَ ذَائِداً، وَلِمَا عِنْدَكَ بِتَحْلِيلِ حَلاَلِهِ وَتَحْرِيم حَرَامِهِ شَاهِداً.
transliteration: waʿṣimnā bihi min howwatil-kufri wa dawāʾi al-nifāq ḥattá yakūna lanā fī al-qiyāmati ilá riḍwānika wa jinānika qāʾidā walana fi al-dunya ʿan sakhatika wa taʿaddi hududika dha'idan wa lima ʿindaka bi taḥlīlī ḥalālihi wa taḥrīmi ḥarāmihi shāhidan
english_text: and preserve us from the pit of unbelief and the motives for hypocrisy, such that the Qur'an may be for us at the resurrection a leader to Thy good pleasure and Thy gardens, for us in this world a protector against Thy displeasure and transgressing Thy bounds and for what is with Thee a witness by its declaring lawful the lawful and its declaring unlawful the unlawful!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَوِّنْ بِالْقُرْآنِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ عَلَى أَنْفُسِنَا كَرْبَ السِّيَاقِ، وَجَهْدَ الأنِينِ، وَتَرادُفَ الْحَشَارِجِ إذَا بَلَغَتِ ألنُّفُوسُ التَّراقِيَ وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاق
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wahawwin bil-qur'ani 'inda al-mawti 'ala anfusina karba al-siyaq wa jaḥdal anīn, wa tarāduf al-ḥashārij 'idha balaghati al-nufus al-taraqiya waqila man raq'
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and through the Qur'an make easy for our souls at death the distress of the driving, the effort of the moaning, and the succession of the rattling, 'when souls reach the throats' (ref.75:26) "and it is said, 'Where is the enchanter"? (75:27)';

arabic_text: وَتَجَلَّى مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِهَا مِنْ حُجُبِ الْغُيُوبِ، وَرَمَاهَا عَنْ قَوْسِ الْمَنَايَا بِأَسْهُمِ وَحْشَةِ الْفِرَاقِ، وَدَافَ لَهَا مِنْ ذَعَافِ الْمَوْتِ كَأْساً مَسْمُومَةَ الْمَذَاقِ،
transliteration: wa tajallā malak al-mawt liqabḍihā min ḥujub al-ghuyūb wa ramāhā ʿan qaws al-manāyā bi-as'humi waḥshati al-firāqِ wadaafa lahā min dḥaʿāfil mawt ka'asān masmūmat al-madhāq
english_text: when the angel of death discloses himself to seize them from behind the veils of unseen things, letting loose at them from the bow of destinies the arrows of the terror of lonesome separation, and mixing for them from sudden death a cup poisoned to the taste;

arabic_text: وَدَنا مِنَّا إلَى الآخِرَةِ رَحِيلٌ وَانْطِلاَقٌ، وَصَارَتِ الأعْمَالُ قَلاَئِـدَ فِي الأَعْنَاقِ، وَكَانَتِ الْقُبُورُ هِيَ الْمَأوَى إلَى مِيقَاتِ يَوْمِ التَّلاَقِ.
transliteration: wa dana minna ila al-akhirati raheelun wa intilaqun wa ṣārati al-aʿmālu qalā'id fi al-aʿnāq wa kānat al-qubūr hiya al-ma'wá ilá mīqāt yawm al-talāq
english_text: and when departure and release for the hereafter come close to us, works become collars around the necks, and the graves become the haven until the appointed time of the Day of Encounter!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي حُلُولِ دَارِ البِلَى وَطُولِ الْمُقَامَـةِ بَيْنَ أَطْبَـاقِ الثَّـرى، وَاجْعَلِ القبُورَ بَعْدَ فِرَاقِ الدُّنْيَا خَيْرَ مَنَازِلِنَا،
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa bārik lanā fī ḥulūl-i dār al-bilā wa ṭūl al-muqāmāti bayna aṭbāqi al-tharā wa-ajʿalil-qubūra baʿda firāqi ad-dunyā khayra manāzilinā
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, make blessed for us the arrival at the house of decay and the drawn out residence between the layers of the earth, appoint the graves, after separation from this world, the best of our waystations,

arabic_text: وَافْسَحْ لَنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي ضِيقِ مَلاَحِدِنَا، وَلا تَفْضَحْنَا فِي حَاضِرِي الْقِيَامَةِ بِمُوبِقَاتِ آثامِنَا،
transliteration: wafsah lana bi-rahmatika fi ḍiqi malāḥidinā walā tafḍaḥnā fī ḥāḍirī al-qiyāmati bimūbiqāti āthāminā
english_text: make roomy for us through Thy mercy the narrowness of our tombs, and disgrace us not among those present at the Resurrection through our ruinous sins!

arabic_text: وَارْحَمْ بِالْقُرْانِ فِيْ مَوْقِفِ الْعَرْضِ عَلَيْكَ ذُلَّ مَقَامِنَا، وَثَبِّتْ بِهِ عِنْدَ اضْطِرَابِ جِسْرِ جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَ الْمَجَازِ عَلَيْهَـا زَلَلَ أَقْدَامِنَا، وَنَوِّرْ بِهِ قَبْلَ الْبَعْثِ سُدَفَ قُبُورنا،
transliteration: wa-irham bil-qurʾani fi mawqifi al-ʿarḍi ʿalayka dhulla maqaminā wa thabbit bihi 'inda idtirab jisri jahannam yawm al-majāzi ʿalayhā zallal aqdāminā wanawwir bihi qabla al-baʿthi sudafa quburuna
english_text: Through the Qur'an have mercy upon the lowliness of our station at the standing place of presentation to Thee, make firm the slips of our feet during the shaking of the bridge across hell on the day of passage over it, illuminate the darkness of our graves before the Uprising,
